summary.headline: Jupiter’s Planetary Configurations
summary.text: Astrological judgments on Jupiter’s configurations with Venus, Mercury, and the Moon, including conjunctions, squares, sextiles, trines, and oppositions, with predictions about chastity, wisdom, rain, merchants, kings, faith, churches, and public affairs.
